macros.open_write: evt.type in (open, openat, openat2, creat) and evt.is_open_write = true
macros.open_read: evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and evt.is_open_read = true
macros.outbound: evt.type = connect and fd.sip exists and fd.sip != "127.0.0.1" and not fd.sip startswith ::1

rules.output: Shell spawned in container (user=%user.name container=%container.id proc=%proc.name parent=%proc.pname cmdline=%proc.cmdline)

rules.condition: open_read and fd.name in (sensitive_file_names) and not proc.name in (read_sensitive_file_trusted, shell_binaries)
rules.output: Sensitive file opened for reading (file=%fd.name proc=%proc.name user=%user.name container=%container.id)
File below /etc opened for writing (file=%fd.name proc=%proc.name user=%user.name container=%container.id)

rules.condition: spawned_process and (proc.exe startswith /tmp/ or proc.exe startswith /dev/shm/ or proc.exe startswith /var/tmp/)
rules.output: Binary executed from a world-writable directory (exe=%proc.exe proc=%proc.name parent=%proc.pname container=%container.id)
Outbound connection from an unexpected process (proc=%proc.name dest=%fd.sip port=%fd.sport container=%container.id)
Container runtime socket accessed (file=%fd.name proc=%proc.name user=%user.name container=%container.id)
